args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (error rate 18%), impacting transactions. Mitigation: rolled back to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0, across all regions. Rollback partially failed due to an orchestrator error during rollout (only us-east updated), and was completed via a v2.3.0 deploy across all regions. Verified service is healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west with error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up is needed to investigate v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator rollback failure.
